run_subsample_dataset: run the script to subsample test images from a BOP dataset using --dataset_dir and --num_scene_images
subsample_images: subsample a given number of images from scene ground truth data using k-means clustering on rotation, translation, and visibility descriptors
quat_geo_dist: compute the geodesic distance between two quaternions representing 3D rotations
closest_centroid: find the index of the nearest centroid for each point in a set of points
generate_test_targets: generate a BOP test targets JSON file with selected image IDs, instance counts, object IDs, and scene IDs
